verdict.rationale: The firm's employment & labor page says its team includes a partner nationally recognized for non-compete/non-solicitation and trade-secret misappropriation matters, which covers employee-mobility disputes and trade-secret work. It also offers self-serve proprietary information and invention assignment agreements, which supports confidentiality programs. The documentation is thin, though, and sits inside a broader employment practice rather than a dedicated trade-secret offering. Missing for 10: a dedicated trade-secret practice page, explicit trade-secret litigation experience or representative matters, and independent corroboration.
